Grade: Grade 2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The 3.5 Healing of the By the end of the Sub strand, the learner ● Learners to r
Topic 3.6: Easter 3.0

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Easter 3.0. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: what took place on Easter Christians?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate Jesus Christ death and resurrection as the way to salvation visited an empty grave

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. appreciate Jesus Christ death and resurrection as the way to salvation visited an empty grave
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate Jesus Christ death and resurrection as the way to salvation visited an empty grave. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Easter 3.0.
2. Explain Easter 3.0 to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Easter 3.0.
4. Show that you can: appreciate Jesus Christ death and resurrection as the way to salvation visited an empty grave
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Easter 3.0. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: what took place on Easter Christians?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. appreciate Jesus Christ death and resurrection as the way to salvation visited an empty grave

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
